defensiveAbilities.name: Transparency
defensiveAbilities.description: Unless they've fed recently, the trawler is naturally fully transparent, allowing them to Hide without concealment or cover and granting them a +4 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to Hide. A trawler loses this transparency if they take a hostile action of any kind.

offensiveAbilities.name: Reel In
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The trawler has a Medium or smaller creature Grabbed with its lasso filament

Effect The trawler pulls the creature toward themself. They attempt an Athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC. A trawler can lift a creature off the ground in this way.

Critical Success The target is moved 20 feet closer to the trawler.

Success The target is moved 10 feet closer to the trawler.

Critical Failure The trawler releases the target.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sticky Filaments
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature hit by the trawler's lasso filament becomes Grabbed by the trawler. The creature isn't Immobilized, but it can't move beyond the range of the lasso filament. A creature is Clumsy 1 for as long as it's grabbed by a lasso filament. A creature can sever the filament with a Strike against AC 19 that deals at least 6 fire or slashing damage. This deals no damage to the trawler but destroys the filament. A trawler has three lasso filaments, and they can't use their lasso filament Strike if all three are destroyed. It takes a week for the trawler to regrow all three of their filaments.

offensiveAbilities.name: Trawler Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d4 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 2d4 Poison Damage damage, enfeebled 2, and Sickened 1 (1 round)

Stage 4 2d6 Poison Damage damage, enfeebled 2, and Sickened 2 (1 round)
